examples: Transformer architecture diagram, encoder-decoder structure. Input embeddings on left, positional encoding added. Encoder stack: N=6 layers each with multi-head attention, add & norm, feed-forward, add & norm. Decoder stack: masked multi-head attention, cross-attention with encoder output, feed-forward. Linear + softmax output. Residual connections shown as curved arrows. Tensor shapes labeled: (batch, seq_len, d_model). 4K, ML paper style.

CNN image classification pipeline. Input image (224, 224, 3). ResNet-50 backbone with conv blocks, batch norm, ReLU, residual connections. Global average pooling. Fully connected layer 1000-d. Softmax output. Each conv block labeled with output shape. Skip connections as curved arrows. Blue #2563eb for conv blocks, orange #f59e0b for FC. 4K.

Microservice architecture for e-commerce. API Gateway at top. Services: User, Product, Order, Payment, Inventory. Each as box. Databases below: UserDB, ProductDB, OrderDB. Message queue for async events. Load balancer at top. Caching layer Redis. Service communication arrows (REST/gRPC). 4K, software architecture style.
accuracy_tips: 模块名和层级名标准化（Conv2D, ReLU, BatchNorm）；张量形状标注准确；数据流方向清晰（输入→处理→输出）；不虚构组件；残差连接用弧形箭头；超参数标注（hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout）；符合主流框架命名。
